clauses.title: Sudden and Accidental Discharge of Water or Steam
clauses.text: Covers sudden and accidental discharge or overflow of water or steam from within a plumbing, heating, air conditioning, or household appliance system.
clauses.warranty_warning: CRITICAL: Do NOT unbolt the anode rod or burner assembly yourself; DIY disassembly voids manufacturer warranty under Clause 9.1.
clauses.dispatch: RapidRooter 24/7 Emergency Plumbing (Direct-Bill Approved, ETA ~22 min)

clauses.title: Freezing of Plumbing and Sudden Pipe Rupture
clauses.text: Covers burst and cracked water pipes caused by pressure surges or freezing, provided heat was maintained in the dwelling.
clauses.warranty_warning: Temporary pipe clamps are acceptable to stop flow. Do not attempt torch soldering or DIY pipe cutting.

clauses.title: Power Surge, Arc Fault & Smart Electrical Panel
clauses.text: Covers sudden and accidental damage to built-in wiring, distribution panels, and connected appliances caused by utility power surges.
clauses.warranty_warning: Preserve damaged breaker trip logs in smart panel telemetry memory for insurance adjuster inspection.

clauses.title: Natural Gas Supply Line Rupture & Emergency Mitigation
clauses.text: Covers emergency gas shutoff and repair of customer-owned interior gas piping following accidental damage or fitting rupture.
clauses.warranty_warning: Gas line repair must be certified by a licensed master gas fitter. DIY repair voids coverage and violates local municipal fire code.
clauses.dispatch: Local Gas Utility Emergency Dispatch + Licensed Gas Fitter (ETA ~15 min)

clauses.title: Carbon Monoxide Evacuation and Appliance Combustion Inspection
clauses.text: Provides coverage for professional boiler, furnace, and venting flue combustion testing following a hazardous CO event.
clauses.warranty_warning: Do not attempt to restart gas boilers or furnaces until inspected by certified HVAC technician.
clauses.dispatch: Call 911 Immediately. Fire Department Hazmat + Certified Flue Inspector.

clauses.title: Fire, Smoke & Soot Damage Mitigation
clauses.text: Covers direct physical loss resulting from fire or smoke, including water damage caused by fire suppression sprinkler systems.
clauses.warranty_warning: Document all damage with photos before cleanup. Do not discard charred appliances until claims adjuster inspection.
clauses.dispatch: Call 911 IMMEDIATELY. Municipal Fire Department Dispatch.

clauses.title: Forced Entry, Burglary & Vandalism
clauses.text: Covers physical damage to doors, windows, and perimeter locks caused by forced entry or attempted burglary.
clauses.warranty_warning: File a formal police report within 24 hours to preserve insurance claim eligibility. Preserve physical evidence.
clauses.dispatch: Call 911 Immediately. Local Police Department Dispatch.

clauses.title: Interior Water Damage & Appliance Overflow
clauses.text: Covers accidental discharge or overflow from washing machines, dishwashers, and internal plumbing fixtures.
clauses.warranty_warning: Professional drying and water extraction must commence within 48 hours to prevent mold exclusion from applying.

clauses.title: Mechanical Breakdown: Central Heating & Air Conditioning
clauses.text: Covers central HVAC compressor and heat-pump mechanical breakdown under the home systems protection endorsement.
clauses.warranty_warning: Attempting manual compressor jump-starting or non-certified refrigerant recharge voids manufacturer 5-year parts warranty.

clauses.title: Garage Door Opener Mechanism & Torsion Spring Failure
clauses.text: Covers motorized garage door opener gear failure and accidental track impact under equipment breakdown riders.
clauses.warranty_warning: Garage door torsion springs are under lethal mechanical tension. Never attempt DIY spring replacement or adjustment.

clauses.title: Major Household Appliance Electrical/Mechanical Breakdown
clauses.text: Covers sudden mechanical or electrical breakdown of major registered home appliances not caused by normal wear and tear.
clauses.warranty_warning: Unplug the unit. Disassembling internal motor housings or sealed refrigeration loops voids manufacturer warranty.
